layout_scope.review_basis: Original fixed candidate-code and footer-page-number columns remain at exact source coordinates, font and size. Body expressions continue to use natural Korean advances.
layout_scope.original_table_scope_review: Original source table grids/cell boundaries remain unchanged. Native symbols in cells without prose stay stationary; only the reviewed full inline group inside its own prose-bearing cell may use natural advances. The first page6 detected structure is a spectral plot rather than a table and is excluded.
layout_scope.legend_scope_review: The original eq/ax glossary below the table uses the source table outer width; native eq/ax/= symbols remain original, Korean directions keep the source12pt size and original baseline.
layout_scope.source_nmr_plot_review: Original NMR plot bars, dotted grid, axis numbers and all native chemical labels stay at exact source geometry/programs; they never join translated annotations into one line. Each original source annotation baseline/start is independent. The amide and benzylic prefixes preserve the original word right edge before the adjacent unchanged native chemical formula, at source point size; 아미드 is the established Korean name for amide. Native ink collision remains zero without excluding any chart ink.

source_centered_table_label_review.review: Plain source table label occupies the complete original source line. Its source center matches the exact original black native grid border centers within the original trailing-space allowance; detected table snap coordinates are not used as actual grid coordinates. Preserve the measured original nonspace word center, point size/baseline/weight and native grid/number columns.
